# XCarry

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** XCarry

## What it does

Hold items in your crafting table slots

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/XCarry.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
